source: This is a string of ancient, hardened clay beads, cracked and faded with age. It was used by Wilders in ancient times, in an attempt to enhance their connection with Nature.
target: 这是一串古朴而坚硬的陶制串珠，年代久远，已经破碎褪色。远古时代，荒野行者曾佩戴它来加强与自然的联系。

source:
#VIOLET#*You are grabbed by two olive-clad warriors and thrown into a crude arena!*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear the voice of the Fighter ring above you.*#WHITE#
%s! Your training begins! I want to see you prove your superiority over the works of magic! Fight!
target:
#VIOLET#*你被两个身着橄榄色服装的战士抓了起来，扔进了一个简陋的角斗场里！*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你听到斗士的声音在你头顶上方响起！*#WHITE#
%s！你的训练开始了！我要看到你证明自己胜过魔法造物！战斗吧！

source:
Enter a calm, focused stance, increasing physical power and accuracy by %d, projectile speed by %d%% and the chance to mark targets by an additional %d%%.
This makes your shots more effective at range, increasing all damage dealt by %0.1f%% per tile travelled beyond 3, to a maximum of %0.1f%% damage at range 8.
The physical power and accuracy increase with your Dexterity. This requires a bow to use.
surface_observation: 百分比占位符后出现空格和英文逗号，标点格式异常
target:
进入一个平静，专注的姿态，增加 %d 物理强度和命中，抛射物速度增加 %d%% 并且标记目标的几率增加 %d%%。
这让你在射程内射击更有效：对三格外目标的距离每增加一格，伤害增加 %0.1f%% , 8 格距离时达到最大值（%0.1f%%）。
物理强度和命中受敏捷值加成。该技能需要弓来使用。

source: #Target# is freed from a bear trap.
#VIOLET#You have found the entrance to a vault!
target: #VIOLET#你找到了通往一处宝库的入口！

source: The time you have spent suppressing the curse has taught you self control. The duration of most non-magical effects are reduced by %d%%.
target: 长年对抗诅咒的经历使你能够自我控制。大部分非魔法效果的持续时间减少 %d%%。

source: The last %d %s talents you learnt are always unlearnable.
surface_observation: unlearnable（不可遗忘）译成“可以遗忘”，含义反转
target: 你最近学习的 %d 个%s技能始终可以遗忘。

source: Attempts to briefly terrify a target into retreating.
target: 尝试恐惧目标使其逃跑。

deep_observation: “绝望”未表达原文的精神失常含义。补查 tome，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/cursed/punishments.lua:311–344：技能名为 Madness，说明明确为 going mad；doMadness 施加 MADNESS_CONFUSED、MADNESS_STUNNED 或 MADNESS_SLOW，与丧失希望的“绝望”语义不同。
surface_observation: Madness（疯狂）译成“绝望”，明显错译

target: 你搜集了一个新的材料：#LIGHT_GREEN#%s%s(%d)#WHITE#。

source: Uses the icons hotkeys toolbar or the textual one.#WHITE#
surface_observation: 英文表示可使用图标或文字快捷栏，译文却说图标快捷栏代替文字快捷栏。
target: 采用图标快捷栏代替文字快捷栏。#WHITE#

source: I require ingredients for three potent mixtures. Obviously, since I seek your aid, none of them is to be found by simply strolling to the local herbalist's. No, they will need to be forcibly parted from their owners who will, just as obviously, put up a fight. I've yet to encounter a naga who would be persuaded to hand over his tongue! Ha! Oh, I am droll at times.
target: 我需要用于配制三种强效药剂的原料。显而易见，既然我向你求助，这些东西就绝非在本地草药铺随便逛逛就能弄到的。不，它们必须从原主身上强行剥离下来，而同样显而易见的是，对方一定会奋起抵抗。我还没遇到过哪只肯被说服乖乖交出舌头的娜迦呢！哈！噢，我有时候还真挺幽默的。

source: A bulbous humanoid form floats here. Its bald, child-like head is disproportionately large compared to its body, and its skin is pock-marked with nasty red sores.
target: 一个臃肿的人形生物漂浮在这里。它的光头像个孩子，与身体相比大得不成比例，皮肤上布满痘坑，长着狰狞的红色脓疮。

deep_observation: 强度3的“对10范围内的一个随机敌人进行报复”与固定源码的目标选择不符，英文说明也存在此偏差。补查 tome，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/timed_effects/other.lua:1517–1547：callbackOnTemporaryEffect 在 p.src 为 actor 时直接对该来源造成精神及暗影伤害，不作10格限制；仅缺少 actor 来源时才从10格内随机选择敌人。译文遗漏了优先反击效果来源的分支。
source:
Horrible visions fill your mind.
#CRIMSON#Penalty : #WHITE#Plagued by Visions: Your mental save has a 20%% chance to be reduced by %d%% when tested.
#CRIMSON#Power 1+: %sRemoved from Reality: %+d Physical Resistance, %+d Maximum Physical Resistance
#CRIMSON#Power 2+: %s%+d Luck, %+d Willpower
#CRIMSON#Power 3+: %sHarrow: When a foe attempts to inflict a detrimental effect upon you, your harrowing aura retaliates against a random foe in range 10, dealing %d mind and %d darkness damage.
#CRIMSON#Power 4+: %sNightmare: Each time you are damaged by a foe there is a chance (currently %d%%) of triggering a radius %d nightmare (summon Terrors and chances to slow, deal %d Mind damage, and deal %d Darkness damage) for 8 turns. The chance grows each time you are struck but fades over time.
surface_observation: 将精神豁免接受检定时误译为“当鉴定时”；将受到敌人伤害误写为“受到目标攻击”。
target:
你的脑海中充斥恐怖景象。
#CRIMSON# 惩罚：#WHITE# 扰乱幻象：当鉴定时，你的精神豁免有 20%%概率减少 %d%%
#CRIMSON# 强度 1+：%s 从现实消失：%+d 物理抗性，%+d 物理抗性上限
#CRIMSON# 强度 2+：%s%+d 幸运，%+d 意志
#CRIMSON# 强度 3+：%s 折磨：当敌人试图对你造成负面效果时，你的折磨光环会对 10 范围内的一个随机敌人进行报复，造成 %d 精神和 %d 暗影伤害。
#CRIMSON# 强度 4+：%s 噩梦：每次受到目标攻击有概率 (当前 %d%%) 触发一个范围为 %d 码的噩梦（有减速、召唤梦魇和直接造成%d精神、%d暗影伤害的效果）持续 8 回合。  触发几率  在每次你受到打击时提高，同时随时间下降。

source: A formation of blue crystal. Its light shines like the ocean's waves.
surface_observation: 英文描述蓝色水晶的构造，译文无依据地写成“生物”。
target: 一个由蓝色水晶构成的生物，它通体荡漾着海蓝色的光芒。

source: This item allows the wearer to attack unseen targets without any penalties.
target: 该物品允许你在攻击不可见单位时不受任何惩罚。
新职业：#LIGHT_GREEN#被诅咒者（痛苦系）

source: Investigate the bastions of the Pride.

deep_observation: “一次精神训练”把长期心智生活改成了一次训练事件。补查 tome，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/psionic/mental-discipline.lua:78–98：Highly Trained Mind 为被动技能，说明使用 A life of the mind 描述长期积累；原文没有“一次”的限定。
source:
A life of the mind has had predictably good effects on your Willpower and Cunning.
		Increases Willpower and Cunning by %d.
surface_observation: Cunning 译成“灵巧”，错作敏捷属性
target:
一次精神训练加强了你的意志和灵巧。
		增加 %d 点意志和灵巧。

source: The target is enveloped in a cursed miasma.
target: 目标被包裹在诅咒瘴气中。

deep_observation: 冻结输入所引 tome 源码 game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:325（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）写的是 humanoid teeth，译为“人类牙齿”将类人生物缩窄为人类；One would have to assume 表明牙齿归属属于推测，译文“那些牙齿并非……而是……”又将其改成确定事实。
source: Hundreds of humanoid teeth have been strung together on multiple strands of thin leather, creating this tribal necklace.  One would have to assume that these are not the teeth of Garkul the Devourer but rather the teeth of Garkul's many meals.
surface_observation: humanoid teeth 被译成“人类牙齿”，缩窄为人类
target: 数以百计的人类牙齿被串在用多股皮革结成的绳索上，组成了这个部落项链。那些牙齿并非吞噬者加库尔自己的，而是来自于加库尔的食物。

surface_observation: Sun Ray 译为“阳光烈焰”，把光线错作火焰

deep_observation: “烟雾弹”把烟雾效果改成了投掷物。补查 tome，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/damage_types.lua:4127–4137：该字符串由 SMOKESCREEN.projector 写入 delayedLogDamage，标记烟幕作用于目标并施加 DIM_VISION 的效果；原文 smoke 指烟雾，没有“弹”的对象含义。
surface_observation: smoke 译为“烟雾弹”，增加了弹体含义

source:
Can you explain the difference in the durations for that "Off-balance" timed effect you're inflicting?

Why is one of the spiders unaffected?

Go learn the Blink spell just to the south, then go back and try it on the spiders.
target:
你能解释一下你施加的“失去平衡”持续效果为何持续时间不同吗？

为什么有一个蜘蛛没受到影响？

去正南方学习“闪现”法术，然后回来在这些蜘蛛身上试试。

surface_observation: grounded 译为“锚定在时间线中”，明显偏离原义

deep_observation: 冻结输入所引 tome 源码 game/modules/tome/data/birth/classes/wilder.lua:262（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）明确包含 the worship of nature，即对自然的崇拜；“训练……自然力量”仅表达力量修习，遗漏了职业背景中的自然崇拜关系。
source: Stone Wardens are dwarves trained in both the eldritch arts and the worship of nature.
surface_observation: worship of nature 被译成“自然力量”，遗漏崇拜含义
target: 岩石守卫是那些同时训练魔法技艺与自然力量的矮人。

source:
An ancient set of robes that has survived from the Age of Allure. Primal magic forces inhabit it.
It was made by Humans for Humans; only they can harness the true power of the robes.
target: 这件古老的礼服从厄流纪保存了下来。上古的魔法力量占据着它。它由人类专门为人类制造；只有他们才能驾驭这件长袍的真正力量。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*Entering the room, you see two massive ogres standing guard, blinking as though awakened from a long sleep. They see you, and immediately draw their weapons.
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*进入房间，你看到两个体型巨大的食人魔正在站岗，眨着眼睛，仿佛刚从漫长的沉睡中醒来。他们看到了你，立刻拔出了武器。
通用 增加暗影抗性穿透

source: You cannot use Eldritch Blow without a shield!
target: 没有盾牌，无法使用奥术盾击！

source: Normally you would be taken as a slave, but you look like you would be more useful as a full-time player, so you can just try again.
target: 通常你会被抓去当奴隶，不过看起来，让你当个长期选手会更有用，所以你只管再试一次。

source: You need an enemy nearby to summon!
target: 需要旁边有一个敌人才能召唤！

source: These dragon scale gloves are tipped with the claws and teeth of a vicious Wyrm. The gloves are warm to the touch.
target: 这件龙鳞手套上嵌着一条恶龙的牙齿与爪子。手套摸上去十分温暖。

deep_observation: 译文遗漏“包括某些技能的额外打击”，并将 archery damage 简化为无基准的“伤害”。补查 tome，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/excellence.lua:151–179：proc 对同一目标的后续调用返回 true，archeryShoot 使用 combatTalentWeaponDamage 作为倍率；第177行明确说明额外打击也被中断、百分比为射击伤害。
source:
Activating this talent enhances your reflexes to incredible levels.  Each time you are attacked in melee, you have a %d%% chance get a defensive shot off in time to intercept the attack, fully disrupting it (including extra blows from certain talents), dealing %d%% archery damage, and knocking the attacker back %d tiles.
		Activating this talent will not interrupt reloading.
surface_observation: 原文段落含换行和制表符，译文删去了该格式；还遗漏了对额外攻击的说明
target: 激活该技能会大幅强化你的反射神经。每次你受到近战攻击，你有 %d%% 的几率进行一次防御性射击来中止对方这次攻击，并造成 %d%% 伤害，同时击退对方 %d 码。激活这项技能不会中断装填弹药。

deep_observation: 译文把选定目标作为恐惧辐射中心、驱逐其周围其他生物的关系改成了直接恐惧范围内目标，遗漏作用中心。补查 tome，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/cursed/dark-figure.lua:33–52：先选取单个 target，再通过 target:setEffect(EFF_RADIANT_FEAR, duration, {radius=radius,...}) 将效果附于该目标；说明明确为 Fear radiates from your target。
source: Fear radiates from your target in a radius of %d for %d turns driving all others away.
surface_observation: 原文是恐惧从目标向外扩散并驱离其他人，译文把半径内其他人写成恐惧的对象，改变了作用方向
target: 恐惧 %d 码半径内的目标以驱逐他们，持续 %d 回合。
